claims.text: A lighthouse keeper climbs the tower stairs in a storm and lights the lamp.
The lighthouse stands on a rocky headland above a rough sea.
The keeper wears a dripping oilskin and carries a storm lantern while climbing narrow spiral stone stairs.
Lightning flashes through a narrow stairwell window; the lamp room door groans open and the lamp has a glass housing, an ignition mechanism, and a rotating lens.
The ignited lamp catches a flame, sends a bright beam through the storm, and a restrained low string score rises beneath the wind.
